(3) A hand holding a long, craggy fried sweet potato stick is shown in a close-up, pulled from a white paper bag with red illustrations. (4) Wide shot of an outdoor street food stall at dusk, featuring bright yellow signage with Chinese characters and customers nearby. (5) Close-up of gloved hands handling small, orange, cylindrical dough pieces in a blue container, followed by a shot of a male staff member in a beige t-shirt and glasses monitoring the frying process. (6) Another close-up of a sweet potato ball being torn open to show the elastic center. (7) Sweet potato balls are poured from a metal funnel into a paper bag, and a pink seasoning bottle shakes white powder over a tray of balls. (9) A hand in a black glove dips several sweet potato sticks into a thick, pale white batter. (10) Fried sweet potato sticks are lifted from the oil, and a close-up shows the soft, orange interior of a broken stick. (11) Final sequence showing two bags of fried food held up in front of the stall exterior, which features multiple air conditioning units on the wall above the sign.
